task_instance: Run the skill's core workflow on a small sample single-particle project: validate a STAR file of CTF-annotated extracted particles and then execute one bounded gold-standard RELION refinement (python scripts/spa_workflow.py validate-star and refine) to produce unfiltered half maps, as a user would invoke this skill for.
blocker_detail: The skill's bundled runner requires software that this offline workstation does not provide and that cannot be obtained without network access: (1) RELION 5.0.1 CPU/MPI executables (relion_refine_mpi, relion_postprocess, relion_image_handler) are not installed; (2) an MPI launcher (mpirun/mpiexec) is absent, and gold-standard half-set splitting requires MPI per the skill; (3) the Python dependencies the runner imports, starfile and mrcfile, are not present in the runtime. Installing any of these would need a package registry over the network, which the runtime forbids.
evidence: Inspected skill tree: SKILL.md, references/*.md and scripts/spa_workflow.py are present (bundled script not missing). Tool probes: 'command -v mpirun mpiexec relion relion_refine relion_refine_mpi relion_postprocess relion_image_handler' returned nothing (exit 1) = none installed. 'python3 -c import starfile' -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'starfile'; mrcfile also not in the base runtime. numpy 2.5.3 is available. Built a minimal realistic sample in <work>/project/particles.star (data_optics + data_particles with voltage/Cs/amplitude-contrast/pixel-size/defocus fields) as valid input a user supplies. Ran 'python3 spa_workflow.py validate-star project/particles.star --project project' -> failed at 'import starfile' (ModuleNotFoundError). Ran the refine command from the skill ('spa_workflow.py refine --star ... --reference project/initial.mrc --diameter 180 --symmetry C1 --initial-lowpass 40 --mpi-ranks 3 --threads 2 --output project/RefinePilot') -> also failed at 'import starfile' during its pre-validation, and would additionally require the absent mpirun + relion_refine_mpi executables. Files produced: <work>/spa_workflow.py (copy of bundled script), <work>/project/particles.star, <work>/result.json. Core deliverable (executing RELION refinement/postprocessing, and even the pure-Python STAR/FSC validation helpers) could not run because the required executables, MPI runtime, and Python libraries are not provided by this offline runtime and cannot be installed without network.
